query: WITH cfg AS (SELECT nullif(current_setting('supautils.policy_grants', true), '')::jsonb AS grants), entries AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(grants -> current_user, '[]'::jsonb)) AS relation_name FROM cfg) SELECT current_timestamp as captured_at_utc, current_user AS execution_role, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_settings WHERE name='supautils.policy_grants' AND context='sighup' AND vartype='string') AS policy_grants_registered, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entries WHERE to_regclass(relation_name)=to_regclass('storage.objects')) AS current_role_storage_objects_policy_grant;
